_comment: What Rookie Rumble's colours MEAN, for the board's key.
Keyed by the colour exactly as written in rookieRumbleColors.json - the named ones as the
author capitalises them, the rest as the same 'r, g, b' string. Kept beside that file rather
than inside it so it stays a verbatim copy of its author's and a new version can be dropped in
without these having to be re-applied.
These names are OURS, not the author's. The squareset format records no name for what a colour
means (see KeywordColor in squareSetFormat.ts) - the author knows Lime is Limgrave and nobody
wrote it down - so each of these is read off the squares that colour actually catches. This set
makes that easy: its own squares name the groups out loud ('Kill 4 bosses in Caelid/
Dragonbarrow', 'Kill 5 bosses in Liurnia/ Chapel of Anticipation'), so six of the seven are the
Fuchsia is the exception and the one judgement call: gimmick kills (+0 weapon, 6+ parries,
consumables only, riding Torrent), dungeon sweeps and scattered collectables. It is the group
that is deliberately nowhere in particular, so it is named for what it asks rather than where.
An empty string means nobody has worked out what a group is. The key then lists that group's
own keywords instead, which is honest and usually enough on a small group.
